notes:
OfficeDex v0.5.41 streamlines generation around the guided planning flow.

What's changed:
- Removed the Fast/Plan mode selector from new generation. Office document generation now uses the guided plan flow by default.
- Kept legacy tasks and drafts compatible: older Fast-mode inputs are handled as plan-mode generation.
- Simplified question screens so the active question and answer controls stay focused without extra status cards above them.
- Improved the image generation workspace with a cleaner template panel, reference image drop/paste support, and better reference previews.
- Added a dedicated desktop notification setting and test action in Settings.

Bundled runtime:
- officecli v0.2.117


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/officecli/officedex/compare/v0.5.40...v0.5.41
